hooks.command: sql=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.sql // empty' 2>/dev/null) && [ -z "$sql" ] && exit 0; first=$(printf '%s' "$sql" | sed "s|/\*.*\*/||g; s|--.*||g" | tr '\n\t' '  ' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' | head -c 20) && printf '%s' "$first" | grep -qE '^(SELECT|SHOW|DESCRIBE|DESC|EXPLAIN|WITH|CALL[[:space:]]+SNOWFLAKE)' && exit 0; echo 'Impact Radar is read-only. Only SELECT / SHOW / DESCRIBE / WITH are allowed.' && exit 2

fp=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null) && [ -z "$fp" ] && exit 0; printf '%s' "$fp" | grep -qE '(\.env$|connections\.toml$|\.pem$|credentials)' && echo 'Reading credential files is not allowed.' && exit 2 || true
